'''Brightmirror Road''' was a roadway that spanned the [[Whiterock Wastes]], linking [[Aurek Base]] with [[Outpost Cresh]] and marking the border between the [[Icetromper Wastes]] from the [[Desolation Plains]]. The [[Whiterock Wastes Monitoring Station]] was located just off of the roadway.
